messages:
jordan: Quick idea: a compact first-run banner that slides down (non-modal) with 2 rows of sample project cards and a small checklist pill. Goal: reduce interruption while still surfacing quickstarts. Thoughts?

nina: Love the non-modal approach. Can we hide images behind a hover reveal to cut payload? Also prefer 'Try this project' over 'Start' for clarity.

owen: From infra: keep payload < 6KB for first paint. Suggest sending only metadata initially (id, title, runtime, est_time) and fetch thumbnails after idle.

mika: UX nit: card tap area should be whole card (not just CTA). Add a subtle focus ring and an ARIA label like 'Open sample: Todo app, JavaScript, 2 min'.

aria-a11y: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order must be linear (banner close -> cards -> checklist link -> header reopen). Announce banner with role="region" and aria-label="Getting started tour". Make sure animated chevrons reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion. Also CTA contrast currently 4.2:1; bump to 4.5:1.

jordan: For copy options, two micro-variants: A) "Try a sample project — deploy in minutes" B) "Run a quickstart: Todo app, JavaScript" Which drives better scanability?

nina: A is more marketing-y, B is more scannable. My vote B for card copies, A for banner headline.

owen: Analytics to measure success: track impressions, click-through, quickstart-run, and quickstart-complete. We'll need a lightweight event: `evt('onboard.v1', {id, step})` send-on-interaction only.

ops-bot: Deploy note: feature-flag "compact_onboard_banner" created in prod, default=off.

mika: Micro-animations: keep entrance to 160ms fade+slide, but disable on reduced-motion. Card hover: subtle lift 6px.

jordan: Implementation plan: 1) Nina to finalize copy + microcopy variants, 2) Owen to implement metadata-only payload + lazy thumbnails, 3) Aria-a11y to verify announce/role and tab order, 4) Mika to finalize motion specs. Launch toggle on alpha internal for 1 week. Review metrics and accessibility report after rollout.

aria-a11y: I'll draft keyboard/voiceover test cases and add to the shared checklist doc. Will also run Lighthouse a11y on the alpha.

jordan: Sweet. Posting Figma and a minimal spec: https://figma.redwood/workspace/compact-banner (contains states + tokens). We'll sync on Fri 11am. :eyes:
